description: This file sets up Python bindings for various AOTI Model Container Runners (CPU, CUDA, XPU, MPS) in the Torch Inductor namespace, including class definitions, method bindings, and external function calls related to tensor handling.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerCpu
classes.description: CPU implementation of the AOTI Model Container Runner with methods for running models, getting call specifications, and managing constants.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerCuda
classes.description: CUDA implementation of the AOTI Model Container Runner with similar methods as CPU, conditionally included.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerXpu
classes.description: XPU implementation of the AOTI Model Container Runner, conditionally included.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerMps
classes.description: MPS (Apple Silicon) implementation of the AOTI Model Container Runner, conditionally included.

methods.name: initAOTIRunnerBindings
methods.description: Initializes Python bindings for AOTI Model Container Runners, defining classes and functions for different hardware backends.
